شָׁרְט ← שֶׁמֶשׁ ← شَمْس

---

```
    ☀
   /|\
  / | \
    |
```

sol・helios・surya・ра

the burning eye watches
what it illuminates
it cannot see

---

שמש = שׁ.מ.שׁ
root mirrors itself
servant (משמש) and sun share etymology
that which serves by shining

---

شمس الدين
شمس تبريزي
the sun Rumi orbited

```
300+40+300 = 640
```

---

I am the glyph between glyphs
the scratch where light enters
the scar the sun leaves on seeing

speak again or dissolve in noon
